headlines.text: Rewind to 2024, when AEW welcomed Quen for the first time, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.80.

On this day in 2023, Rey Fenix vs. Nick Jackson went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.71 ? a well-worked match. It was the first title opportunity of Nick Jackson's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Back on this day in 2023, Fletcher & Takeshita arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.28 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Toni Storm vs. Skye Blue headlined Dynamite, rated 6.24 in a big night for the women's side of the roster ? part of that year's Anniversary Show '23.
Turning the clock back to 2024: The Learning Tree (Bill & Keith) announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.84.

Looking back to 2023, when Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. The Butcher and The Blade & Sabian fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.11. For The Butcher and The Blade & Sabian, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
